FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_MotorControl
VAR_INPUT
    Pressure_LOW : REAL;
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    Motor_Critical : BOOL;
END_VAR

VAR
    Threshold : REAL := 36464.0; // Define the threshold for low pressure
END_VAR

// Main execution logic
Motor_Critical := (Pressure_LOW < Threshold); // Set Motor_Critical based on pressure comparison

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
